name: What are the main stages of the garage remodeling process?

mainEntity.name: What are the main stages of the garage remodeling process?

acceptedAnswer.text: The project begins with a site walkthrough to evaluate concrete foundations, existing framing, and intended use. Once scope is established, demolition of old shelving or damaged drywall occurs, followed by rough carpentry and electrical coordination. Insulation goes in next, followed by hanging, taping, and texturing drywall. Finally, our in-house crew completes interior painting, baseboard molding, and custom finish carpentry. Owner Abraham Becerra serves as the on-site lead, directly inspecting drywall seams and framing alignments throughout every milestone.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves through site assessment, rough framing, trade rough-ins, drywall hanging and taping, and final paint and finish carpentry.
